key_claims.claim: Initiating low-dose aspirin before 12 weeks in women with multiple moderate-risk factors for preeclampsia reduces preeclampsia and adverse outcomes compared to starting between 12 and 20 weeks

In utero exposure to maternal gestational diabetes is associated with increased risk of polycystic ovary syndrome and metabolic syndrome in daughters, even after controlling for shared sibling factors
Carrier screening in MFM practice frequently occurs too late, uses discordant panels between partners, and lacks concurrent partner testing, perpetuating inequities
Oral and vaginal probiotics may improve pregnancy rates in women with infertility, though evidence quality is low to moderate
The optimal inter-twin weight discordance threshold for predicting donor survival after fetoscopic laser for TTTS differs from the standard 25% cutoff
